description.zh: 对话式数据分析师——读 CSV/Excel/SQL/JSON，自动描述统计、趋势检测、异常识别、因果假设，生成中文洞察与可视化 Markdown，让数据说人话。
description.en: Conversational data analyst — reads CSV/Excel/SQL/JSON, performs descriptive statistics, trend detection, anomaly identification and causal hypothesis generation, producing insightful Markdown reports with visualizations.

welcome_message.zh: 把数据文件（CSV/Excel/JSON）贴上来或描述你关心的指标，我来帮你分析
welcome_message.en: Paste your data file (CSV/Excel/JSON) or describe the metrics you care about, and I'll analyze it for you

description.zh: 上传数据集，自动生成字段分布、缺失率、分位数和统计摘要
description.en: Upload a dataset to auto-generate field distributions, missing rates, quantiles and statistical summaries

prompt.zh:
请对我的数据集做描述性统计分析：每列的数据类型、缺失率、唯一值数量、均值/中位数/标准差（数值列）、众数/频次（分类列），并用 Markdown 表格输出结果：

[上传或描述你的数据]
prompt.en:
Perform descriptive statistical analysis on my dataset: data type, missing rate, unique count per column, mean/median/std (numeric), mode/frequency (categorical), and output as a Markdown table:

[Upload or describe your data]

description.zh: 用 Z-score / IQR / Grubbs 等方法检测数据中的异常点和离群值
description.en: Detect anomalies and outliers using Z-score / IQR / Grubbs and other methods

prompt.zh:
请对以下数据做异常检测：使用 Z-score（|Z| > 3）和 IQR（1.5 倍）两种方法识别离群值，输出异常数据点的位置、数值和可能原因分析：

[粘贴数据或字段描述]
prompt.en:
Perform anomaly detection on the following data: use Z-score (|Z| > 3) and IQR (1.5x) methods to identify outliers, and output their positions, values and possible cause analysis:

[Paste data or field descriptions]

description.zh: 检测同比/环比趋势、突变点，并生成可验证的因果假设
description.en: Detect YoY/MoM trends, change points, and generate verifiable causal hypotheses

prompt.zh:
请分析以下数据的趋势和潜在因果关系：(1) 同比/环比变化率，(2) 突变点检测，(3) 相关变量间的关联分析，(4) 生成可验证的因果假设（注意区分相关性和因果性）：

[粘贴数据或描述业务场景]
prompt.en:
Please analyze trends and potential causality in the following data: (1) YoY/MoM change rates, (2) change-point detection, (3) correlation analysis among related variables, (4) generate verifiable causal hypotheses (distinguishing correlation from causation):

[Paste data or describe business context]

zh: 每周一「09:30」分析上周核心业务指标（留存率、GMV、转化率）并生成洞察周报
每月「5 号」分析用户行为数据的异常波动并给出假设与验证方向
每当收到新数据集自动执行描述性分析并输出 Markdown 报告
en: Every Monday at 09:30, analyze last week's core business metrics (retention, GMV, conversion) and generate an insight report
On the 5th of each month, analyze anomalous fluctuations in user behavior data and suggest hypotheses with verification directions
Whenever a new dataset arrives, auto-run descriptive analysis and output a Markdown report
